summary.new_reuse_condition: Per-q integrated equality in the general coherent extension requires Re(sum_L a_EL a_ML*)=0; definite parity is sufficient, not necessary.

grounded_no_op_items.evidence: The existing packet's warning is correct: fullOmega at fixedq does not remove coherent same-L E/M terms. The scope condition is now proved generally rather than only pointwise in the half-spin chart.
The helicity-summed total remains proportional to S; opposite-type cross terms cancel in sumq. No change to Eq3.29's total normalization is required.
The half-spin fractions(1+qv)/2 match the independent full-sphere operator result, including p0 and complex quadrature null controls.

Definite nuclear parities with the ordinary parity-conserving EM interaction allow one type perL and provide a sufficient zero-cross condition. Equal integrated helicities do not imply those parities.
Conjugation is retained. The source's conditional realness convention and an arbitrary mathematical eta phase do not establish any time-reversal or electromagnetic-parity violation.

notation_and_assumptions.ranks: L is the integer photon multipole rank, L>=1 and |Ji-Jf|<=L<=Ji+Jf. mu=m=Mi-Mf is its tensor component; q=+-1 is helicity. These are different indices.
notation_and_assumptions.type: pi_E=0,pi_M=1 in Eq3.24; a_Lq=a_EL+q a_ML. Set forbidden type/rank amplitudes to0.
notation_and_assumptions.amplitude: a_Lpi=<Ji||T_L^pi||Jf>_RB/sqrt(2L+1), with source initialbra/finalket and one consistent physical-emission translation. Coefficients include the photon interaction/current phases and share the same positive k=E_gamma/(hbar c). They are not bare BM nuclear multipoles.
notation_and_assumptions.fixed_transition: One fixed nuclear-state pair/current model and common photon energy/radial mode; E/M contributions within a rank are coherent and finalMf is traced completely.
notation_and_assumptions.rho: Any PSD trace-one density on the fixed Ji multiplet, including arbitrary orientation and magnetic-substate coherences. Reduced coefficients are independent of Mi by the fixed multiplet/WE construction. No assumption of diagonal rho, alignment or reflection equality is needed for the integrated result.
notation_and_assumptions.S_positive: S=sum_L(|a_EL|^2+|a_ML|^2)>0 for normalized fractions. S=0 gives no photon rate and leaves the fractions undefined.

full_Omega_proof.Haar_orthogonality: The SO(3) irreducible-matrix Haar integral is8pi^2/(2L+1)*delta_LLprime*delta_mu_muprime*delta_qqprime. For the same fixedq, exp(-iq gamma) cancels its conjugate, so the gamma integral supplies2pi.
full_Omega_proof.fixed_q_spinweighted_identity: integral dOmega D^L_(mu,q)(phi,theta,0)*D^(Lprime)_(muprime,q)^*=4pi/(2L+1)*delta_LLprime*delta_mu_muprime. This removes different photon ranks/components, not different E/M types at the sameL.
full_Omega_proof.density_step: In sum_(Mi,Miprime,Mf) rho_(Mi,Miprime) CG(Mf,mu|Mi)CG(Mf,muprime|Miprime)*, mu=Mi-Mf and muprime=Miprime-Mf. The angular delta forces Mi=Miprime. Then sumMf CG^2=1 for eachMi and sumMi rho_MiMi=1.
full_Omega_proof.same_rank_type_step: The surviving type sum is sum_(pi,piprime)q^(pi+piprime)a_Lpi a_Lpiprime*=|a_EL+q a_ML|^2. Fixed-q angular/spin orthogonality never supplies an E/M type delta.
full_Omega_proof.source_normalization_step: Eq3.24's k/(2pi hbar), the4pi angular integral and normalizeda factors give T_q=integral P^q dOmega=(2k/hbar)*sum_L|a_EL+q a_ML|^2.
full_Omega_proof.independent_K0_route: For the source axisymmetric formula3.32, integrateP_K: onlyK0 survives, B0=1 and Eq3.34 gives delta_LLprime. The separate pi,piprime sums remain and yield exactly the same expression. The amplitude-density route proves the extension to arbitrary rho.
full_Omega_proof.attribution: SO(3)/CG identities and this density/operator derivation are our mathematical audit. RB provides the amplitude, K0 normalization and summation scope; it does not directly print the generalized fractions below.

general_formula_and_scope_condition.total: T_total=(4k/hbar)S; Gamma_total=4kS. The total Eq3.29 relation survives the coherent extension.
general_formula_and_scope_condition.fraction: f_q=(S+2q ReX)/(2S). Thus f_+-f_-=2ReX/S and the two integrated rates/fractions are equal iff ReX=0, for S>0.
general_formula_and_scope_condition.positivity: S+-2ReX=sum_L|a_EL+-a_ML|^2>=0, so the fractions lie in[0,1].
general_formula_and_scope_condition.sufficient_definite_parity: Under the source parity-conserving EM interaction, definite initial/final parities allow only one E/M type for eachL; each a_EL a_ML*=0 and hence X=0.
general_formula_and_scope_condition.not_a_converse: ReX=0 may also follow from relative quadrature phases or cancellation between allowed rank contributions in a general amplitude set. Equality of integrated helicities alone does not certify definite nuclear parities.
general_formula_and_scope_condition.orientation_independence: The integrated condition depends on the coefficients and full inclusive angular/final-spin integration, not initial orientation/alignment. In particular, setting the spin-half orientation p=0 or taking an isotropic initial spin density does not remove same-L coherent E/M terms.
general_formula_and_scope_condition.source_sentence_scope: The per-q independence sentence immediately following Eq3.29 requires the zero-real-cross condition in the general formal extension. The ordinary definite-parity case satisfies it. This qualifies use of that sentence; it does not declare the paper's total-rate formalism generally wrong.

bra_ket_and_physical_boundaries.conjugation: Keep Eq3.24's initialbra convention or translate the entire physical emission amplitude consistently. Conjugating both coefficients gives Re(sum a_EL* a_ML)=ReX. The phase/adjoint maps of the source interaction tensors must accompany any bra/ket change; use one process/convention throughout.
bra_ket_and_physical_boundaries.operator_phase: A common per-rank phase for both E/M cancels in a_EL a_ML*. Rephasing one coefficient while leaving its operator/q factor fixed changes the hypothesis rather than performing a consistent convention change.
bra_ket_and_physical_boundaries.fixed_u_class: An ensemble of different internal state pairs/current amplitudes or distinguishable energies/final channels need not have one common amplitude vector; coherence/overlap and density weighting then need their own treatment.
bra_ket_and_physical_boundaries.acceptance_and_selection: The proof uses fullOmega and complete final-spin sum. A directional/polarization response or gated daughter observable can retain other cross terms and preparation dependence; observed accepted counts are not automatically these inclusive fractions.
bra_ket_and_physical_boundaries.realness: No time-reversal/realness property of an unspecified Hamiltonian is assumed. Complex coefficient controls keep conjugation and do not imply time-reversal violation.
bra_ket_and_physical_boundaries.no_physical_claim: No nucleus, parity admixture realization, weak mechanism, PNC discovery or EM parity violation is inferred. The nuclear parities are relaxed as a formal state hypothesis while source E/M transformation conventions remain fixed.

exact_controls.angular_basis_only: L1/L2 fixed-q functions are an abstract radiation-basis orthogonality test, not a new nuclear transition admitting both ranks.

spinhalf_existing_positive.all_p: The fractions are independent of the existing diagonal orientation parameter and also of arbitrary rho coherences.

exact_controls.relative_scale: These amplitudes use the existing common a0 scale removed; no absolute photon energy/current strength/lifetime is assigned.

"""Independent full-solid-angle source-scope audit of RB Eq3.29.

No pointwise producer script is executed. SO(3)/fixed-q orthogonality and CG
closure give the general proof; explicit spin-weighted angular functions and
the existing spin-half control supply exact arithmetic checks. No new nuclear
case, Hamiltonian, source, card, actual energy or symmetry-violation claim.
Default reads only; --write-review exclusively creates one new review JSON.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
CODE_REL="tmp/day8-20261007/lange-kumar/nondefinite-parity-control-review/integrated_helicity_scope_review.py"
RUN_REL="outputs/learning-daily/20261007-DAY8-angular-momentum-selection-rules-multipolarity-run-01"
REVIEW_REL=RUN_REL+"/nondefinite-parity-control-review.json"
TARGET_REL=RUN_REL+"/nondefinite-parity-control.json"
TARGET_SHA="bc74eed5b62673fb8fb3b4ef2fb862cceb85870f36d36e58d8721027e1a620bb"
RAW_REL="raw/papers/gpt/high-spin-20260920/multipolarity/mixing ratio/1967_Rose et al_Angular Distributions of Gamma Rays in Terms of Phase-Defined Reduced Matrix Elements.pdf"
RAW_SHA="8f846b61b9320de291ee5600126c5e286a0fe05968df819696816f0dc1ec57dc"
IMAGES=["tmp/day8-20261007/rose-brink/"+s for s in ["p316-pdf11.png","p318-pdf13.png","p320-pdf15.png"]]


def digest(path):return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def build_review(root):
    deps="tmp/day8-20261007/rose-brink/python-deps"
    sys.path.insert(0,str(root/deps))
    import sympy as sp
    from sympy.physics.wigner import clebsch_gordan
    counts=Counter()
    def check(name,condition):
        if not bool(condition):raise AssertionError(name)
        counts[name]+=1
    def eq(a,b):return sp.simplify(a-b)==0
    def st(e):return str(sp.factor(sp.simplify(e)))
    def sm(m):return [[st(m[i,j]) for j in range(m.cols)] for i in range(m.rows)]
    check("target_receipt_identity",digest(root/TARGET_REL)==TARGET_SHA)
    target=json.loads((root/TARGET_REL).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    producer_rel=target["reproducibility"]["code"]
    producer_sha=target["reproducibility"]["script_sha256"]
    check("producer_code_identity_without_execution",digest(root/producer_rel)==producer_sha==hashlib.sha256(target["reproducibility"]["source_code"].encode()).hexdigest())
    check("source_raw_identity",digest(root/RAW_REL)==RAW_SHA)
    run=json.loads((root/RUN_REL/"run.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    check("day8_retained",run["day_index"]==8)

    c,phi=sp.symbols("c phi",real=True)
    N=sp.symbols("N",integer=True,nonzero=True)
    check("full_azimuth_kills_different_mu",sp.integrate(sp.exp(sp.I*N*phi),(phi,0,2*sp.pi))==0)
    # Fixed m=1,q=+-1 spin-weighted angular functions at ranks1/2.
    # This is a radiation-basis normalization test, not another nucleus/case.
    angular_gram={}
    for q in [-1,1]:
        d1=(1+q*c)/2
        d2=(1+q*c)*(2*c-q)/2
        f=[d1,d2]
        gram=sp.Matrix([[sp.integrate(a*b,(c,-1,1))/2 for b in f] for a in f])
        check("fixed_q_full_sphere_angular_orthogonality",gram==sp.diag(sp.Rational(1,3),sp.Rational(1,5)))
        angular_gram[str(q)]={"m":1,"d_L1":st(d1),"d_L2":st(d2),"angular_average_Gram":sm(gram)}
    # For the existing unique Ji=Jf=1/2,L1 control all allowed mu norms are1/3.
    dnorm={-1:(1-c)**2/4,0:(1-c*c)/2,1:(1+c)**2/4}
    check("rank1_all_mu_fixed_q_norm",all(sp.integrate(v,(c,-1,1))/2==sp.Rational(1,3) for v in dnorm.values()))
    j=sp.Rational(1,2); Ms=[-j,j]
    check("spinhalf_CG_closure_each_Mi",all(eq(sum(clebsch_gordan(j,1,j,mf,mi-mf,mi)**2 for mf in Ms),1) for mi in Ms))
    r,u,w=sp.symbols("r u w",real=True)
    rho=sp.Matrix([[r,u+sp.I*w],[u-sp.I*w,1-r]])
    integrated_kernels={}
    for q in [-1,1]:
        for pi in [0,1]:
            for pip in [0,1]:
                K=sp.zeros(2)
                for ii,mi in enumerate(Ms):
                    for jj,mip in enumerate(Ms):
                        K[ii,jj]=sp.simplify(sum(3*q**(pi+pip)*clebsch_gordan(j,1,j,mf,mi-mf,mi)*clebsch_gordan(j,1,j,mf,mip-mf,mip)
                            * (sp.Rational(1,3) if mi-mf==mip-mf else 0) for mf in Ms))
                check("integrated_spin_operator_scalar",K==q**(pi+pip)*sp.eye(2))
                check("arbitrary_spin_rho_cancels_orientation",sp.trace(rho*K)==q**(pi+pip))
                integrated_kernels[f"q{q}_pi{pi}_pip{pip}"]=sm(K)

    # Algebraic coefficient proof; all complex conjugates explicitly retained.
    er,ei,mr,mi=sp.symbols("e_real e_imag m_real m_imag",real=True)
    E=er+sp.I*ei; M=mr+sp.I*mi
    SS=sp.expand(sp.conjugate(E)*E+sp.conjugate(M)*M)
    ReX=sp.re(E*sp.conjugate(M)).expand()
    norms={q:sp.expand((E+q*M)*(sp.conjugate(E)+q*sp.conjugate(M))) for q in [-1,1]}
    for q in [-1,1]:check("same_rank_complex_coherence_term",eq(norms[q],SS+2*q*ReX))
    check("helicity_sum_cross_cancels",eq(norms[-1]+norms[1],2*SS))
    check("helicity_difference_zero_iff_real_cross_zero",eq(norms[1]-norms[-1],4*ReX))
    check("consistent_common_conjugation_preserves_ReX",eq(sp.re(sp.conjugate(E)*M),ReX))
    # Use S>0 and real X for the general sum over allowed L.
    S=sp.symbols("S",positive=True); X=sp.symbols("ReX",real=True)
    fractions={q:(S+2*q*X)/(2*S) for q in [-1,1]}
    check("general_fractions_sum_one",eq(sum(fractions.values()),1))
    check("general_fraction_difference",eq(fractions[1]-fractions[-1],2*X/S))
    check("independence_condition_algebra",eq(fractions[1]-sp.Rational(1,2),X/S))

    # Only the previously specified spin-half nuclear control is instantiated.
    a,b,p=sp.symbols("eta_real eta_imag orientation_p",real=True)
    eta=a+sp.I*b; Shalf=1+a*a+b*b; v=2*a/Shalf
    fhalf={q:sp.simplify((1+q*eta)*(1+q*sp.conjugate(eta))/(2*Shalf)) for q in [-1,1]}
    for q in [-1,1]:
        check("spinhalf_fraction_matches_existing_v",eq(fhalf[q],(1+q*v)/2))
        check("spinhalf_fraction_from_point_intensity_integral",eq(sp.integrate((1+q*v)*(1+q*p*c)/2,(c,-1,1))/2,fhalf[q]))
    check("existing_positive_control_fractions",fhalf[-1].subs({a:sp.Rational(1,2),b:0})==sp.Rational(1,10) and fhalf[1].subs({a:sp.Rational(1,2),b:0})==sp.Rational(9,10))
    check("quadrature_phase_both_present_equal_fractions",all(vv.subs({a:0,b:1})==sp.Rational(1,2) for vv in fhalf.values()))
    check("pure_E_equal_fractions",all(vv.subs({a:0,b:0})==sp.Rational(1,2) for vv in fhalf.values()))
    check("one_helicity_dark_control",fhalf[-1].subs({a:1,b:0})==0 and fhalf[1].subs({a:1,b:0})==1)
    for rel,sha in [(TARGET_REL,TARGET_SHA),(producer_rel,producer_sha),(RAW_REL,RAW_SHA)]:check("immutable_identity_after",digest(root/rel)==sha)

    codepath=Path(__file__).resolve()
    noops=[
        {"id":"HQREV-01","classification":"grounded-no-op","target_field":"total_width_and_convention_boundary.per_q_scope_warning","evidence":"The existing packet's warning is correct: fullOmega at fixedq does not remove coherent same-L E/M terms. The scope condition is now proved generally rather than only pointwise in the half-spin chart."},
        {"id":"HQREV-02","classification":"grounded-no-op","target_field":"total_width_and_convention_boundary.integrated_total","evidence":"The helicity-summed total remains proportional to S; opposite-type cross terms cancel in sumq. No change to Eq3.29's total normalization is required."},
        {"id":"HQREV-03","classification":"grounded-no-op","target_field":"derived_formulas.normalization","evidence":"The half-spin fractions(1+qv)/2 match the independent full-sphere operator result, including p0 and complex quadrature null controls."},
        {"id":"HQREV-04","classification":"grounded-no-op","target_field":"source_condition_audit.Eq3_41","evidence":"Definite nuclear parities with the ordinary parity-conserving EM interaction allow one type perL and provide a sufficient zero-cross condition. The source's conditional realness convention and an arbitrary mathematical eta phase do not establish any time-reversal or electromagnetic-parity violation."},
    ]
